description: List the tickets you opened (this session/key), newest activity first. Use get_support_ticket to read a thread and poll for replies.
name: list_support_tickets

has_more.description: True when more tickets exist past this page.

tickets.description: Your tickets (this session/key), newest activity first.

last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of the last user/admin message (UTC).

opener_type.description: Who opened the ticket, snapshotted from the account type at creation.

status.description: awaiting_reply | answered | closed. `closed` is terminal (an auto-closed ticket can be reopened by replying within 7 days).

total.description: Total tickets for this principal (ignores pagination).

title: List your support tickets
